subject: math
description: Calculate Q1, Q2, and Q3 from ungrouped data and interpret what each quartile means.
learningObjectives: Order ungrouped data and identify the median as Q2.
Calculate Q1 and Q3 by finding the medians of the lower and upper halves.
Interpret Q1, Q2, and Q3 in the context of a data set.
Avoid common quartile errors, including using unordered data or confusing Q3 with the maximum.
prerequisites: Order numbers from least to greatest
Find the median of odd and even data sets
Write a short interpretation using evidence
